findings.issue: A contract test evaluates Ridge performance on the test set every time the test suite runs.
findings.why_it_matters: Repeatedly consulting test performance undermines the intended one-time final test evaluation. Use validation performance for this assertion and reserve the test set for final evaluation.

findings.issue: The row-loss test enforces an upper bound but does not assert the exact expected row count.
findings.why_it_matters: Some unexpected row loss could remain undetected as long as it stays below the upper bound. Explicit row-count accounting would strengthen the check.
